# Northwind Bakery

> A neighbourhood bakery in Fort Kochi, baking naturally leavened sourdough since 2011.

## Pages

- [Home](https://northwind.example.com/): what we bake and when it comes out of the oven
- [About](https://northwind.example.com/about): the starter, the flour and the people
- [Keeping a sourdough starter alive](https://northwind.example.com/guides/sourdough-starter): feeding ratios and troubleshooting
